source.title: Call for Applications - WCA Competition Announcement Team Leader (October 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

There will be an appointment of a new WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) Leader, as Zeke Mackay’s term is ending. We would like to thank Zeke for the work he has done leading the Team.
<!-- break -->

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong leadership skills to provide guidance, support, and direction to WCAT members
* High level of attention to detail to ensure accurate and compliant competition announcement
* Strong decision making abilities
* Very good knowledge of the relevant policies, particularly the Competition Requirements Policy
* Excellent communication skills with an ability to convey information clearly and professionally

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from **now until November 15th, 2025, 23:59 UTC.** Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistant Team ([assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org)), CC’ing the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

1. Brief personal introduction
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA
3. Ambitions as the WCAT Leader

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WCAT can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2024.2](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of [WCA Motion 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 比赛公示组负责人招募（2025 年 10 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

Zeke Mackay 的任期即将结束，WCA 比赛公示组（WCAT）将任命一位新负责人。感谢 Zeke 在带领团队期间所做的工作。

<!-- break -->

申请人应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周为团队工作至少 8 小时。我们希望申请人具备以下能力：

* 较强的领导能力，能够为 WCAT 成员提供指导、支持和明确的工作方向。
* 细致认真，确保比赛公告准确、符合要求。
* 较强的决策能力。
* 熟悉相关政策，尤其是《比赛要求政策》。
* 出色的沟通能力，能够清楚、专业地传达信息。

申请材料提交时间为**即日起至 2025 年 11 月 15 日 23:59 UTC**。有意者请将申请私下发送至董事会助理团队（[assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org)），并抄送 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

1. 简短的自我介绍。
2. 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
3. 担任 WCAT 负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料。

WCAT 的权利和职责见 [WCA 决议 10.2024.2](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将依据 [WCA 决议 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节投票选定并公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
